panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 8 panels (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H). B: Ki67 IHC of same omental ATLL infiltrate showing ~90% proliferation, supporting aggressive T-cell lymphoma / ATLL. C: CD3 IHC shows same atypical lymphoid proliferation positive for T-lineage marker in HTLV-1 positive stage IV ATLL case. D: CD2 IHC shows same atypical lymphoid proliferation positive for T-lineage marker in ATLL case. E: CD5 IHC shows loss of expression in same atypical lymphoid sheets, aberrant T-phenotype supporting ATLL. F: CD7 IHC shows loss of expression in same atypical lymphoid sheets, aberrant T-phenotype supporting ATLL. G: CD4 IHC shows uniform positivity in same atypical lymphoid sheets, CD4+ aberrant phenotype supporting ATLL. H: CD8 IHC shows negativity in same atypical...
panels.attribution_text: Krishnamurthy et al. Rare Peritoneal Involvement in Adult T-Cell Leukemia/Lymphoma: A Diagnostic Conundrum.. Cureus 2025. doi:10.7759/cureus.87342. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 2.
panels.figure_caption: Immunohistochemistry suggesting aggressive T-cell lymphoma (A) H&E stain of left upper quadrant omental mass biopsy showing confluent sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells (see arrow). (B-H) The atypical cells show a proliferation index of approximately 90% by labeling for Ki67, are positive for T-lineage markers (CD3, CD2), show loss of CD5, CD7, and are uniformly positive for CD4, while negative for CD8 (see arrows) (original magnifications X400). H&E: hematoxylin and eosin
in_text_mentions: Ultrasound-guided biopsy of an omental implant for confirmation revealed large atypical lymphoid cells showing an aberrant T-lineage phenotype by immunohistochemistry (CD3+, CD2+, CD4+, CD8-, CD5-, CD7-) with Ki67 proliferative index of approximately 90%, indicative of an aggressive T-cell lymphoma (Figure 2). Peripheral blood real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) was positive for human T-lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV-1), and the patient was diagnosed with stage IV ATLL given ascitic fluid involvement.

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 6 panels (A, B, C, D, E, F). A: H&E skin biopsy showing atypical epidermotropic lymphocytic infiltrate, captioned as concerning for adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma in HTLV-1 positive patient with article title cutaneous ATLL. B: CD3 IHC of same atypical infiltrate concerning for ATLL, panel-specific caption plus HTLV-1 positive cutaneous ATLL context. C: CD4 IHC of same atypical infiltrate concerning for ATLL, panel-specific caption plus HTLV-1 positive cutaneous ATLL context. D: CD7-negative (loss of CD7) IHC showing atypical infiltrate area, captioned concerning for ATLL with in-text loss of CD7 raising concern for ATLL. E: CD8 IHC panel of same biopsy captioned as part of atypical infiltrate concerning for ATLL; shows infiltrate despite ATLL typically CD4+. F: CD25-positive atypical T cells on IHC directly matches vocabulary term, panel-specific caption concerning for ATLL in HTLV-1 positive cutaneous ATLL case.
